name: Penalty Calculation Record 1
definition: Specifies the details for the penalty calculation.

Date.name: Date
Date.definition: Date for which the penalty applies.

MissingReferenceData.name: Missing Reference Data
MissingReferenceData.definition: Information provided for  penalties where there is missing reference data on this business day.||Usage: When not present, there are no missing reference data.

FinancialInstrumentAttributes.name: Financial Instrument Attributes
FinancialInstrumentAttributes.definition: Further details on the financial instrument reported.

DiscountRate.name: Discount Rate
DiscountRate.definition: Discount rate for the currency of the penalty, provided if the Security is subject to penalties and if the calculation method code is cash, mixed or both.

ForeignExchangeData.name: Foreign Exchange Data
ForeignExchangeData.definition: Further details on the foreign exchange rate.

SubAmountPenaltyBreakdown.name: Sub Amount Penalty Breakdown
SubAmountPenaltyBreakdown.definition: Breakdown into sub-amounts that compose the penalty total amount.
